findings.description: An affiliate of Zurich Alternative Asset Management paid $47.4 million ($603/sq ft) for the 76,000–78,500-square-foot office building at 410 Townsend Street, built in 1912 with exposed brick and heavy timber construction, buying from New York Life Real Estate Investors and Bridgeton Holdings. The building was 65% occupied; former tenants named in the story (Yammer, Eventbrite, Zendesk) are not recorded here. It last sold for $22 million in 2024 and $85.65 million in 2019.

findings.description: Al Pastor Papi, a taqueria in a former Chipotle space at 232 O'Farrell Street that opened via the city's Vacant to Vibrant program in July 2025, is to close 31 December 2026 after new building ownership set a triple-net lease of $25,000/month, about triple the prior rent.
